verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair privacy axis for a data-pipeline platform like Airbyte, but the evidence pack documents no retention settings, deletion controls, or data-purge capability. CDC reading DELETE statements from source logs is about replicating source changes, not about the user controlling retention. Self-hosting the open-source edition is at most a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
